scene_summary: A glossy rubber-hose cartoon pile of monsters, skulls, goo creatures, boxes and fanged puddle-mouths fills the lower half of a flat cobalt-blue field. At center, a pink blob character raises both pink hands to lift a gold-rimmed oval mirror into the open blue sky. The mirror holds a collage face of eyes, lips, a checkerboard, a star and a sleeping profile.
usable_surfaces: pink ground plane with fanged puddle-mouths
red fanged maw at top-left corner

detected_objects.label: Pink raised hands lifting gold-rimmed oval collage-face mirror
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Two splayed pink hands with glossy highlights grip the lower left and right edges of a thick yellow oval rim set against open cobalt. Inside the rim is a collage face made of a large eye, red lips, a checkerboard, a pink sleeping face, a profile face, a yellow star on black and blue waves. The pink arms descend to a pink blob character looking upward.
